Bill.BriefDescription: Collecting the monorail motor vehicle excise tax upon initial registration.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to collecting the monorail motor vehicle excise taxupon initial registration; amending RCW 35.95A.130; providing aneffective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 35.95A.130 and 2002 c 248 s 14 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The special excise tax imposed under RCW 35.95A.080(1) will becollected at the same time and in the same manner as ((relicensing))tab fees for initial registrations and renewals under RCW 46.16.0621and 35.95A.090. Every year on January 1st, April 1st, July 1st, andOctober 1st the department of licensing shall remit special excisetaxes collected on behalf of an authority, back to the authority, at nocost to the authority. Valuation of motor vehicles for purposes of thespecial excise tax imposed under RCW 35.95A.080(1) must be consistentwith chapter 82.44 RCW.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of the p. 1 HB 2248state government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2005.
